title: Container Bookings: Settings That Lift the Cancellation Fee
content:
Two tier settings in Container Bookings determine when a cancellation is freed of its fee: the number of carrier rolls a booking must have suffered, and whether a rejected dangerous-goods acceptance frees the cancellation.

| Booking product | Carrier rolls on the booking that free the cancellation | Line's rejection of the dangerous-goods acceptance frees the cancellation |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 2 | yes |
| AHL Spot Flex | 1 | yes |
| AHL Contract Booking | 1 | yes |
| AHL Contract Priority | 1 | yes |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 1 | yes |
| AHL Premium Express | 1 | yes |

## Points of judgement

- The count in the first column refers to rolls caused by the carrier and recorded on that same booking; rolls the customer caused are not part of it.
- AHL Spot Saver needs two such rolls; each other product needs one.
- The second setting is switched on for every product.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An AHL Spot Saver booking that the carrier has rolled once has not yet reached the count of 2 in the table, whereas an AHL Spot Flex booking rolled once by the carrier has reached its count of 1. The booking histories here are invented for illustration.
